description: PulseGrid 16-step drum sequencer tools for Composio / MCP agents

tools.name: Export PulseGrid Pattern
tools.description: Return the current PulseGrid pattern JSON (v4/v5) for banks A/B, BPM, swing, song chain.

tools.name: Export Suno Custom Mode Package
tools.description: Build paste-ready Suno TITLE, STYLE OF MUSIC, and LYRICS (instrumental drum bed) from pattern density and BPM.

tools.name: Export Shoom AI Prompt
tools.description: Build Shoom-style genre + mood + description + title for AI song/video generation.

tools.name: Export Faves Share Card
tools.description: Create a human-curation share blurb for faves.fm / social (title, BPM, tags, why fave).

tools.name: Push Pattern to GitHub Gist
tools.description: Via Composio GitHub toolkit: create a gist with pulsegrid-v5 JSON + README.

tools.name: Save Pattern to Notion
tools.description: Via Composio Notion toolkit: create a page with pattern summary and JSON code block.

tools.name: Get GM MIDI Map
tools.description: Return General MIDI drum note map used by PulseGrid (ch 10 default).

agent_workflow: 2. Optionally PULSEGRID_EXPORT_SUNO / SHOOM / FAVES for creative copy
3. Push via GITHUB_CREATE_GIST or NOTION_CREATE_PAGE through Composio connected account
4. For music gen: hand Suno/Shoom text to user (no direct API) or BeatAPI via Composio if connected
